newsitem.title: USA: Servico common shares listed on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Servico common shares listed on NYSE.

text.p: Shares of Servico Inc, a hotel operator, are now listed on the New York Stock Exchange, the company said Monday.
The stock was previously listed on the American Stock Exchange. Trading on the Big Board began on June 19.
Spear, Leeds & Kellogg is a specialist firm for the stock.

Servico either owns or manages 60 hotels under the brands Holiday Inn, Best Western, Clarion, Crowne Plaza, Days Inn, Embassy Suites, Hampton Inn, Hilton, Howard Johnson, Omni, Quality Inn, Radisson, Sheraton and Westin.
